$comment: Source: CMHC Canadian registered covered bond program pages under https://www.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/professionals/project-funding-and-mortgage-financing/securitization/canadian-registered-covered-bonds/canadian-covered-bonds-registry. Field semantics were confirmed against all ten currently published program pages (Bank of Nova Scotia, BMO, CIBC, Equitable Bank, Fairstone, FCDQ, Laurentian, National Bank, RBC and TD).
title: CMHC Canadian Registered Covered Bond Program
description: JSON Schema for one CMHC Canadian registered covered bond program page. A page has an issuer/program profile table followed by one bond-issuance-parameters table per outstanding covered bond. Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates, amounts are numbers, and percentages/rates are numbers rather than formatted strings. Optional fields are omitted when the printed cell is 'NA' or 'N/A'.

sourceUrl.description: URL or path the program page was parsed from, when known.

issuerName.description: Issuer Name from the program profile table.

programName.description: Program Name from the program profile table, e.g. 'Global Registered Covered Bond Program'.

minimumAssetPercentage.description: Minimum Asset Percentage printed in the program profile table, e.g. 80.0.

maximumAssetPercentage.description: Maximum Asset Percentage printed in the program profile table, e.g. 95.0.

bonds.description: Bond issuance parameter tables, in printed order.

parties.description: Named parties and roles in the program profile table. The printed label for the custodian/trustee role varies: most pages print separate 'Custodian' and 'Bond Trustee' rows, while the Fairstone page prints a single 'Bond Trustee, Custodian and Titleholder' row. Exactly one of those forms is present.

guarantorEntity.description: Value of the row labelled 'Guarantor Entity's Name [and the name of its general partner(s) or trustees(s)]'. The printed value contains the guarantor entity, managing general partner and liquidation general partner.

counterpartiesToCoveredBondCollateralHed.description: Value of 'Counterparty(s) to the Covered Bond Collateral Hedge'. May name multiple counterparties.

eligibleLoanServicers.description: Value of 'Eligible Loan Servicer(s)'. May name multiple servicers.

originators.description: Value of 'Originators'. Present on the Fairstone page only; omitted when the row is absent.

custodian.description: Value of 'Custodian'. Omitted when the page uses the combined 'Bond Trustee, Custodian and Titleholder' row instead.

bondTrustee.description: Value of 'Bond Trustee'. Omitted when the page uses the combined 'Bond Trustee, Custodian and Titleholder' row instead.

bondTrusteeCustodianAndTitleholder.description: Value of the combined 'Bond Trustee, Custodian and Titleholder' row used on the Fairstone page. Omitted when separate custodian and bond-trustee rows are present.

payingAgent.description: Value of 'Paying Agent'. May name multiple agents. The Laurentian Bank page omits this row, so the property is optional.

portfolioManager.description: Value of 'Portfolio Manager'. The printed value may be 'None' or 'N/A'.

accountBank.description: Value of 'Account Bank/Guaranteed Deposit Account Provider' or the equivalent 'Account Bank/Guaranteed Investment Contract Provider' label. Whitespace around the slash varies on the printed pages.

standbyAccountBank.description: Value of 'Standby Account Bank/Standby Guaranteed Deposit Account Provider' or the equivalent 'Standby Account Bank/Standby Guaranteed Investment Contract Provider' label.

bond.description: One 'Bond issuance parameters' table. Soft-bullet bonds must also have an extended maturity date.

issueCurrency.description: Issue Currency as a three-letter ISO 4217 code, e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'CHF', 'GBP', 'CAD', 'NOK', 'AUD', 'SGD'.

nominalAmount.description: Nominal Amount in the issue currency. The printed value uses thousands separators, e.g. '188,000,000'.

bulletType.description: Hard Bullet/Soft Bullet column normalized to lower case. The pages print both 'Soft' and 'Soft Bullet'.

interestPaymentFrequency.description: Interest Payment Date(s)/Frequency normalized to a lower-case frequency. The pages contain the typos 'Anually' and 'Semi-anually'; both are normalized.

listingAuthority.description: Listing Authority (if applicable). Omitted when the printed value is 'NA'.

otherMaterialCharacteristics.description: Other Material Characteristics as Applicable. Omitted when the printed value is 'NA'. Some older FCDQ tables print the whole row as 'NA' rather than using the full label.

isin.description: The printed ISIN cell. Most bonds have one ISIN; US-dollar Regulation S / Rule 144A issues print two, with the designations 'Reg S' and 'Rule 144A' or '144A'.

displayText.description: Printed cell text with whitespace normalized, e.g. 'Reg S: USC0574BAB48 Rule 144A: US06418BAB45'.

designation.description: Printed designation before the colon, e.g. 'Reg S', 'Rule 144A' or '144A'. Omitted when the cell contains a plain ISIN with no designation.

coupon.description: The 'Coupon Rate (%)' cell. It is either a fixed annual rate or a floating rate expressed as an index plus a spread.

displayText.description: Printed coupon text with whitespace normalized, e.g. '3.250', 'SOFR + 0.65', 'Compounded Daily SONIA + 75 bps' or '3 month BBSW + 105 bps'.

kind.description: Normalized form of the coupon: a fixed percentage or an index plus spread.

fixedRatePercent.description: Fixed annual coupon rate in percent. Required when kind is 'fixed'.

index.description: Floating-rate index name, e.g. 'SOFR', 'Compounded Daily SONIA', '3 month BBSW', 'BBSW' or 'EURIBOR'. Required when kind is 'floating'.

spreadPercent.description: Spread over the index in percentage points. Basis-point values are divided by 100 (105 bps becomes 1.05). Required when kind is 'floating'.

amount.description: A non-negative monetary amount. Use a JSON number, not a formatted string.

percent.description: A percentage expressed as a number in the range 0-100 (for example 80.0, not 0.80).

rate.description: An annual interest rate expressed as a percentage in the range 0-100.

spread.description: A spread over an index, expressed in percentage points.

date.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). The printed pages use long English dates such as 'September 28, 2015' or '22 July 2013'; normalize before validation.
